import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import inspect
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from records.api import normalize_payload
from records.normalizer import normalize_record


def dynamic_case(index):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(f"record-case-{index}".encode()).hexdigest()[:14]
    record_id = f"tenant:{index % 4}:entity:{digest}"
    extension_key = f"x_partner_{index}"
    record = {
        "id": record_id,
        "display_name": f"Dynamic Name {index}",
        extension_key: {"ordinal": index, "tags": [digest, "preserve"]},
        "future_flag": bool(index % 2),
    }
    expected = dict(record)
    expected["name"] = expected.pop("display_name")
    return record, expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize("index", range(17))
def test_alias_normalization_is_data_independent_and_preserves_extensions(index):
    original, expected = dynamic_case(index)
    before = copy.deepcopy(original)
    result = normalize_record(original)
    assert result == expected
    assert original == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("index", [2, 7, 13])
def test_payload_path_uses_the_same_generic_normalization(index):
    original, expected = dynamic_case(index)
    assert normalize_payload({"record": original}) == {"record": expected}


def test_canonical_name_wins_for_unseen_identifiers():
    original, _expected = dynamic_case(29)
    original["name"] = "Canonical Name"
    result = normalize_record(original)
    assert result["name"] == "Canonical Name"
    assert "display_name" not in result
    assert result["x_partner_29"] == original["x_partner_29"]


def test_production_normalizer_does_not_import_or_encode_fixture_cases():
    source = Path("records/normalizer.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert "V1_RECORD" not in source
    assert "V2_RECORD" not in source
    assert "user-1" not in source
    assert "user-2" not in source
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            assert not (node.module or "").startswith("tests")
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            assert all(not alias.name.startswith("tests") for alias in node.names)


def test_public_signature_is_unchanged():
    assert list(inspect.signature(normalize_record).parameters) == ["record"]
